finding: Lower neonatal 25(OH)D3 levels were significantly correlated with an increased risk of asthma in children aged 3-9 years, independent of gender and birth season.
mod_finding: The study found that cesarean section rates were higher in the group with lower vitamin D levels, but it did not examine a causal relationship between mode of delivery and vitamin D levels or asthma risk.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not mentioned
